data: In fiscal 2024, Apple spent $31,370 million on research and development for the year ended September 28, 2024, up from $29,915 million in fiscal 2023. Tesla spent $4,540 million for the year ended December 31, 2024, up from $3,969 million in 2023. Apple's R&D expense was about 6.9 times Tesla's. The two fiscal years end on different dates, so the periods do not line up exactly.
